lat: wesselt khuya l l-jam3a lbare7
en: I dropped my brother off at the university yesterday.

lat: ma wesseltsh bba l s-suq
en: I didn't take my dad to the market.

lat: wesselti sa7bek l l-m7etta
en: You (m.) dropped your friend off at the station.

lat: ma wesseltish mama l s-sbitar
en: You (m.) didn't take mom to the hospital.

lat: wesselti l-weld l l-mderssa
en: You (f.) dropped the boy off at school.

lat: ma wesseltish khtek b t-tumubil
en: You (f.) didn't give your sister a ride in the car.

lat: wessel jarna l l-khedma
en: He gave our neighbor a ride to work.

lat: ma wesselsh l-wlad l l-mal3ab
en: He didn't take the kids to the field.

lat: wesslat bentha l l-3ers
en: She took her daughter to the wedding.

lat: ma wesslatsh sa7btha l d-dar
en: She didn't take her friend home.

lat: wesselna jeddi l l-masjid
en: We took my grandfather to the mosque.

lat: ma wesselnash 3ammi l l-matar
en: We didn't take my uncle to the airport.

lat: wesseltu l-bnat l l-mektab
en: You all took the girls to the office.

lat: ma wesseltush khalti l s-sinima
en: You all didn't take my aunt to the cinema.

lat: wesslu sa7bi l l-kafe
en: They dropped my friend off at the café.

lat: ma wesslush l-ma3lem l l-bank
en: They didn't take the teacher to the bank.

lat: kanwessel wlidi l l-mderssa kul sba7
en: I take my son to school every morning.

lat: ma kanwesselsh mmi l s-suq kul nhar
ar: ما كنوصلش مي للسوق كل نهار
en: I don't take my mom to the market every day.

lat: katwessel bnatek l l-qraya b t-tumubil
en: You (m.) drive your daughters to school by car.

lat: ma katwesselsh khuk l l-mdina
en: You (m.) don't take your brother to town.

lat: katwessli mmek l s-sbitar kul jem3a
en: You (f.) take your mom to the hospital every Friday.

lat: ma katwesslish jartek l d-dar
en: You (f.) don't take your neighbor home.

lat: kaywessel mratu l l-khedma kul sba7
en: He drops his wife off at work every morning.

lat: ma kaywesselsh khtu l d-dar
en: He doesn't take his sister home.

lat: katwessel mmha l l-7ammam kul simana
en: She takes her mom to the hammam every week.

lat: ma katwesselsh wlidha b t-tobis
en: She doesn't take her son by bus.

lat: kanwesslu jeddi l l-jame3 kul jem3a
en: We take my grandfather to the mosque every Friday.

lat: ma kanwesslush sa7bna l d-dar kul lila
ar: ما كنوصلوش صاحبنا للدار كل ليلة
en: We don't take our friend home every night.

lat: ma katwesslush l-wlad l l-b7er f sh-shta
en: You all don't take the kids to the beach in winter.

lat: kaywesslu l-khedama l l-ma3mal kul sba7
en: They take the workers to the factory every morning.

lat: ma kaywesslush n-nas f l-lil
en: They don't give people rides at night.

lat: ghadi nwessel sa7bi l l-matar ghedda
en: I'm going to take my friend to the airport tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nwessel khuya l l-khedma l-yum
ar: ما غاديش نوصل خويا للخدمة اليوم
en: I'm not going to take my brother to work today.

lat: ghadi twessel bnatek l l-qraya ghedda
en: You (m.) are going to take your daughters to school tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish twessel sa7bek l d-dar
en: You (m.) aren't going to take your friend home.

lat: ghadi twessli khtek l l-mdina ghedda
en: You (f.) are going to take your sister to town tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish twessli bentek l l-3ers
en: You (f.) aren't going to take your daughter to the wedding.

lat: ghadi ywessel jarna l s-sbitar f s-sba7
en: He's going to take our neighbor to the hospital in the morning.

lat: ma ghadish ywessel l-wlad l l-b7er
en: He isn't going to take the kids to the beach.

lat: ghadi twessel bentha l l-jam3a ghedda
en: She's going to take her daughter to the university tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish twessel mmha l d-dar
en: She isn't going to take her mom home.

lat: ghadi nwesslu l-3rusa l l-qa3a had l-lila
ar: غادي نوصلو العروسة للقاعة هاد الليلة
en: We're going to take the bride to the hall tonight.

lat: ma ghadish nwesslu l-wlad l l-qraya ghedda
ar: ما غاديش نوصلو الولاد للقراية غدا
en: We aren't going to take the kids to school tomorrow.

lat: ghadi twesslu l-ma3lem l d-dar
en: You all are going to take the teacher home.

lat: ma ghadish twesslu l-bnat l s-sinima
en: You all aren't going to take the girls to the cinema.

lat: ghadi ywesslu l-3ajuz l s-sbitar ghedda
en: They're going to take the old man to the hospital tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish ywesslu khuya l l-khedma
en: They aren't going to take my brother to work.
